# Ergen Tekstil

> Ergen Tekstil is a Turkish manufacturer of seamless (dikişsiz) apparel founded in 2004: leggings, shapewear, shorts, activewear, underwear and thermal wear. It integrates knitting, dyeing, sewing and packaging, has a production capacity of 200,000 pieces per month, produces private-label for brands and exports to Europe, Africa and Asia. It is a B2B / wholesale manufacturer: products have no retail prices; buyers request a quote.

## Key facts

- Founded: 2004
- Business model: B2B manufacturer, private label (OEM) and wholesale; no retail sales
- Capacity: 200,000 pieces/month
- Markets: Europe, Africa and Asia (exports to three continents)
- Own brand: Formactive
- Head office: Karaağaç OIZ, Eski Bağlar Cad. No:6 59510 Kapaklı / TEKİRDAĞ, Türkiye
- Branch office: Yeşildirek, Suriçi Mahallesi, Sultan Mektep Sk. No:13/A, 34120 Fatih, İstanbul, Türkiye
- Email: info@ergentekstil.com
- Phone: +90 534 593 68 91, +90 216 420 49 84
- Website languages: Turkish (default), English, Arabic, German, Russian

## About

Ergen Tekstil was founded in 2004 as a company integrating knitting and garment facilities to manufacture seamless apparel. Today, with a production capacity of 200,000 pieces/month, it is one of the leading quality manufacturers in its field. Through the effective use of technology and an innovative approach, we recognize that adapting quickly to a changing world and prioritizing innovation are essential values.

In line with our growth targets, the construction of our own factory in the Tekirdağ Kapaklı Organized Industrial Zone is progressing rapidly. Once complete, it will both increase our capacity and bring us one step closer to our goal of expanding into new international markets. As a manufacturing brand, Ergen Tekstil aims to strengthen its position among global competitors through effective branding in production. The company continuously pursues learning and development with its dedicated team. While prioritizing sustainable production methods, we value effective communication with our business partners and foster a culture of ownership, confidence and happiness among our team members.

## Collections

- Active Wear: Our activewear collection is designed to keep comfort and performance at their peak in every movement.
- Underwear: Our underwear products bring together all-day comfort and elegance, making you feel special at every moment.
- Shapewear: Our shapewear collection gives your body the perfect shape while offering all-day comfort and support.
- Women's Active Sportswear: Our women's collection blends elegance and style with modern designs, created to add a touch of style to every moment.
- Men's Active Sportswear: Our men's collection, with modern and stylish designs, helps you feel comfortable and confident in every setting.
- Functional Textiles: Our products are equipped with innovative technologies, offering both performance and comfort together.
